name: Angelalign Technology Inc.
summary: Angelalign Technology Inc., an investment holding company, researches and designs, manufactures, sells, and markets clear aligner treatment solutions in the People's Republic of China and internationally. The company's products include Angel Aligner Pro and Angel Aligner Select, a custom made removable clear orthodontic aligners that move the patient's teeth into the proper position over time; Angel Aligner KiD, a early orthodontic solution from prevention to treatment; and Angel Aligner Retainer.
